title: Public Service Algorithm: towards a transparent, explainable, and scalable content curation for news content based on editorial values

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the average rating distributions of individual human editors and applying the Interquartile Range (IQR) method for outlier detection to identify subjective scoring tendencies (e.g., 'strict' vs. 'lenient' raters) in order to contextualize the ground truth.

Evaluating the alignment between LLMs and human expert baselines on a 'Diversity' criterion, which tests the models' ability to identify and score news articles featuring under-reported communities and marginalized groups based on age, gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, or disability.
